what: Deck key fit test: the stirrer's deck key at three nub interferences (0.05, 0.10 and 0.15 mm a side), one of each, on one plate
request_text: @claude-print print the deck keys (one each size- 0.05mm, 0.10mm and 0.15mm)
printer_choice: A1 mini: the request named no printer; the base whose pockets the keys go into was printed on the A1 mini in the same PETG (print/2026-10-21-a1mini/)

go.after_seeing: 20261022T211049Z_camera.jpg, posted with the request for the go at 21:23:21Z; the request listed: plate empty and Textured PEI, bed path clear, the PETG in A4 turning freely, someone able to reach the printer

source.imported_as: deck_key_press_0.05.stl, deck_key_press_0.10.stl (a byte-identical copy of stl/deck_key.stl, renamed so the three names line up), deck_key_press_0.15.stl; as three objects, not one object with parts
source.orientation: nub up, as in the STLs; Studio placed each turned 180 degrees about Z (nub point toward +Y, dimples toward -Y), which changes nothing for a part symmetric about its long axis
source.layout: Studio's Arrange, 10 mm spacing, no auto-rotate; bounding boxes on the 180 x 180 mm bed from the file's plate_1.json (mm, X then Y)

slicer.app: Bambu Studio 02.08.02.61 (AppImage) on the CI runner, bundled profiles (the 2.8.0.6 configuration update was cancelled)
slicer.printer_preset: Bambu Lab A1 mini 0.4 nozzle (set by Sync info from the printer; the empty project had started as an A1)
slicer.filament_preset: Bambu PETG Basic @BBL A1M 0.4 nozzle (GFG00), white, project filament 3 (filaments synced from the AMS Lite: 1 PLA Basic dark blue, 2 PLA Basic black, 3 PETG Basic white)

changed_in_gui.objects: all three set from filament 1 (PLA) to filament 3 (PETG) with Change Filament
changed_in_gui.why: BUILD.md stage 1: PETG, at least 4 walls, 30 % infill or more, elephant-foot compensation, no supports; the same settings as print/2026-10-21-a1mini

slicer.checked_in_config_block: wall_loops = 4, sparse_infill_density = 30%, elefant_foot_compensation = 0.15, enable_support = 0, curr_bed_type = Textured PEI Plate, printer_settings_id = Bambu Lab A1 mini 0.4 nozzle

gcode_checks.how: check_slice.py on deck_key_fit_test.gcode.3mf; output in check_slice_output.txt
gcode_checks.nub_layers_measured: z 10.2-11.6, the 8 layers below the 0.3 mm lead-in
gcode_checks.dimples_how: each a hole in the pill's top two layers (z 9.8 and 10.0) ringed by an outer-wall loop drawn as arcs; the loops' centres are 1.1 or 2.2 mm apart along X, 8.5 mm from the key's centre
gcode_checks.first_layer_note: outer-wall centrelines of the 9.8 x 24.77 mm pill: half the 0.5 mm first-layer line width and the 0.15 mm elephant-foot compensation in from each side
gcode_checks.features: no brim, skirt, support or prime tower
gcode_checks.start_gcode: M620 S2A (load filament 3, 0-based 2, from the AMS), M412 S1, M190 S70, M109 S245

estimates.model: 17m 33s (G-code header); the GUI showed 16m 43s plus 6m 3s prepare

send.printer: Thumbelina, the A1 Mini (Bambu Lab A1 mini, 0.4 mm)
send.route: Bambu Studio on the runner, logged in to the lab's Bambu account (password + authenticator code), sent through Bambu's cloud
send.ams_mapping: project filament 3 (PETG Basic, white) -> AMS Lite A4

sent_file.how: copied from /tmp/bamboo_model/.../Metadata/.<pid>.0.3mf, which Studio writes at Send; only DesignerUserId blanked

printer_before.state: idle after the last job (stir_module_parts, 100 %, Finished), no HMS alerts (Studio Device page and Assistant (HMS))

timeline_utc: Studio set up: certificate prompt, wizard, plug-in, beta prompts, configuration update cancelled
Confirm; logged in, A1 mini selected by Studio
Device page: idle, no HMS alerts, heaters off, PETG Basic in A4
Sync info, AMS filaments synced, three STLs imported, arranged, set to PETG, settings set, sliced (21:18:10)
go asked for in the thread
fresh Device-page check and frame: idle, plate unchanged
downloaded; bed heating to 70 (preheat had shown 65, the PLA value, during the download), nozzle to 170
filament change: PETG loaded from A4 (nozzle read up to 257 C)
waiting for the bed to reach 70
the three keys on the plate, gantry parked high (20261022T215000Z_finished.jpg)
keys taken off the plate by someone in the lab
watching: Studio's Device page, OCR about every 11 s and a camera crop each time (watch_a1m.py, an A1 mini copy of PR #234's bambu/studio/watch_studio.py); no new windows, no pause, no HMS alert; the HMS list was empty after the print
recording: the runner's screen was recorded in 1 min segments; the segments covering the login were deleted at once and the rest was not kept: claude-print.yml has no YouTube token. timelapse.mp4 / timelapse.gif are the watcher's camera crops from layer 1 (21:32:56) to 21:51:41, one about every 11 s, room blurred
outcome: finished: layer 60/60 and Finished at 21:49:16, 24.0 min after Send against Studio's 23 min 36 s; no pause, dialog or HMS alert. The keys were taken off the plate by 21:51:41. Fit not yet reported
